description: A402: every Aseman action, its resource type, the subject classes that may hold it, and the least-privilege rule that replaces the legacy guard. Unknown actions deny (ADR 0008).

resources.node: The local Aseman node (diagnostics, identity, cluster, telemetry)
resources.raw_state: Raw legacy node keys; no subject is ever granted access (LD-24)
resources.creature: A creature or user identity record, its metadata and type
resources.creature_signal: A direct signal to a creature
resources.finance_system: The node's financial system as a whole
resources.store: A store: records, signals, history, membership
resources.program: A program and its metadata and alarm
resources.entity: A program entity and its deployed files
resources.workload: A running workload (VM instance): lifecycle, logs, terminal, files

conditions.public: No authentication: anyone, including anonymous callers
conditions.self: The resource is the subject itself
conditions.owner: The subject owns the resource (a creature's owner, a program's machine owner, a store's creator)
conditions.same_creature: A workload acting on resources of the creature it is bound to (A405 trusted binding)
conditions.secret_grantee: A live secret grant to the subject
conditions.counterparty: The subject is a party to the financial record (payer, payee, pool member)
conditions.finance_operator: The subject holds the finance operator role
conditions.node_admin: The subject holds the node administration role
conditions.granted: An explicit capability grant for this action and resource (A403)
conditions.never: Never allowed; the surface is removed at the phase in `removal`

legacy_guards.guest: any code running in a VM, unauthenticated host call (LD-14/LD-24)
legacy_guards.http_cluster: cluster HTTP, peer network trust only

actions.summary: The node's public key and minimal identity
The node's peer map (minimal federated descriptors)
Guest call into a node protocol API
actions.removal: P4-04 (LD-14: forwarded guest-chosen operations to the identity-less callback protocol)

actions.summary: Read raw legacy node keys (the guest calls that used to reach them are confined guest data, ADR 0028)
Write or delete raw legacy node keys (the guest calls that used to reach them are confined guest data, ADR 0028)
Legacy email login returning a custodial key
Check a signature against a creature key
Enroll a canonical key with a legacy key proof
Update a creature or its metadata
List secrets granted to the subject
Execute a command in a workload
Copy files into or out of a workload
Take or release a workload resource lock
A guest calling a signed shell action; the inner action is authorized as itself
Create or update a resource store
Create or update a resource entity
The creature's own guest data: dbOp, runtime state (stateOp), confined documents and links (ADR 0021, ADR 0028)
Outbound HTTP from a workload (deny by default, A406)
Delegate an attenuated grant from one the subject holds
Revoke a grant and, with it, every descendant
